question: What lactic acid and acetic acid concentrations did the well-fermented alfalfa silage group (LPGood) have?
rendered:
Document: "Fermentation Quality Divergence of Alfalfa Silage within the Same Batch: Insights from 16S rRNA Sequencing and Untargeted Metabolomics"

The LPGood group showed significantly (p < 0.05) higher LA (lactic acid) and AA (acetic acid) concentrations than the LPBad group. 

The values for the LPGood group were:
- LA: 9.18 ± 0.46 g/kg DM
- AA: 11.27 ± 0.16 g/kg DM
